newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares tread water, await economic data.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares tread water, await economic data.

text.p: Norwegian shares continued to tread water on Tuesday with investors remaining cautious ahead of a stream of domestic economic data due over the coming two weeks.

Brokers said activity could pick up after the Central Bank's quarterly inflation forecast at 11 a.m. local time (0900 GMT) on Wednesday. But business might remain patchy until the government releases the 1997 national budget on October 4, they said.
Oslo's Total share index was little changed at 840.46 points, a dip of 0.04 percent. Turnover was 649 million crowns.
Telecommunications group Nera took a slide, falling eight crowns to 226 crowns in trade worth 105 million crowns.
Dealers said the seller of a large block in the company had depressed the price.
"The market's "wait-and-see" sentiment is leading to exaggerated moves in specific shares," noted one broker.
Shipbuilding, engineering and offshore group Kvaerner jumped eight crowns to 254 crowns in the A stock on positive sentiment to a series of company presentations, dealers and analysts said.
Kvaerner Bs rose seven crowns to 231 crowns.
